moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio e-rough, written here): Target moves 0 → 100 % along a jittery curve, 1200 ms: rough({points: 20, strength: 1}). Site demo approximation: p + (noise(22 p, seed 3) − 0.5)·0.18·sin(π p), clamped to −0.1…1.1 — up to ±9 % wobble mid-way, none at the ends (seeded value noise, smoothstep between 22 points). Site demo: 1200 ms across 114 px. Params: duration (1.2 s) · points (20) · strength (1) · seed.
